scope: All named critical, mixed, administrative and lead-only voices recovered in this pass; not a complete Vatican witness roll

people.name: Elvira Serritelli
people.role_or_credentials: Lay spiritual daughter; born 1890 according to Capuchin biography
people.position: Alleged sexual relationship about 1922–1930, followed by Morcaldi.
people.nuance: Her own alleged experience and her claim about another woman require separate corroboration. Full signed statement/recording missing. A secondary Spanish reproduction uses conditional language attributed to Maccari and reports the phrase without malice; the full original context is needed.
people.locator: Positio IV, pp. 127–130, via Luzzatto; dates vary 1921/1922
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected
people.followup: Earlier complaints referenced to Agostino Diario p.154 and later biographies; first disclosure of personal affair unresolved. Continued confession to 1965 remains a single explicit retrospective claim; Ciccone independently recalls her taking him to Mass in childhood.

people.name: Carlo Maccari
people.role_or_credentials: Apostolic visitor in 1960; later Archbishop of Ancona-Osimo
people.position: Criticized truthfulness, boundaries, discipline and cult administration.
people.nuance: Doubted Serritelli according to Luzzatto’s reading; retained Morcaldi concerns; also acknowledged benefits of confession and proper celebration of Mass. No established intercourse finding recovered.
people.locator: Positio IV pp. 103–141; diary pp. 160–171; later memorandum pp. 419–442
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Girolamo Bortignon
people.position: Adverse/concerned voice explicitly heard ex officio.
people.nuance: Separate complete testimony missing. Supportive accounts connect him with financial disputes; motive allegations need checking. Do not assign him Maccari’s every charge.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Giustino da Lecce
people.category: Documented concerned friar; formal cause witness
people.position: Concerned about lay control; participated in surveillance.
people.nuance: Later mistakes/apology reported; does not establish retraction of every observation.
people.locator: Positio II pp. 378, 384; Mischitelli, Il Confratello p. 162
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Umberto Terenzi
people.role_or_credentials: Priest, rector/parish priest of Divino Amore, Rome
people.position: Transmitted complaints and recordings to officials.
people.nuance: One transmission chain does not create additional eyewitnesses to the alleged affair. Later formal hearing unverified.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Paolo Philippe, O.P.
people.role_or_credentials: Dominican Holy Office consultor; later cardinal
people.position: Adverse Relazione e voto dated 20 March 1961; published excerpts explicitly assert sexual intercourse and conscious false mysticism.
people.nuance: Published1961 excerpts contain serious adverse judgments. A later published quotation of his8February1969 report acknowledges the earlier report was too severe and over-weighted accusations and Maccari. Full1969 report unread; no blanket recantation inferred. Not an independent eyewitness to intercourse.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected
people.followup: Reassessment published by Campanella2010, printed53, notes6–7 on57: Relazione e voto8February1969, ds.DF255/19 pp.5and4. Includes reported judicial-process reservations. This materially qualifies the earlier dossier’s emphasis on his1961 conclusion. Complete signed reports remain uninspected.

people.name: Pasquale Gagliardi
people.position: Reported disorder, commercialization and women’s access.
people.nuance: Observed access/care and an inference of sexual misconduct are different. Accusations against Gagliardi do not themselves refute his claims.
people.locator: Printed pp. 137–138; notes to chapter V
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Giuseppe Prencipe
people.position: Interviewed in Rossi’s 1921 inquiry.
people.nuance: Specific complete testimony still needed; no blanket fraud allegation assigned here.
people.locator: Printed p. 147 and subsequent inquiry discussion
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Domenico Palladino
people.position: Adverse local voice in the 1921 dossier.
people.nuance: Later oral retraction reported by Alberto D’Apolito; no written retraction recovered.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Michele De Nittis
people.position: Named among early local opponents in later biographies.
people.nuance: Original adverse statement not recovered; not an independently verified fraud witness.
people.locator: Yves Chiron, Padre Pio: Le stigmatisé, Spanish public edition
people.access_status: Lead only

people.name: Amico Bignami
people.role_or_credentials: Professor of medical pathology, Royal University of Rome
people.position: Proposed pathology and possible chemical maintenance after 1919 examination.
people.nuance: Medical hypothesis is distinct from observing deliberate fabrication.
people.locator: Published 1919 report in Di Flumeri, Le stigmate
people.access_status: Published medical report available in existing collection

people.name: Agostino Gemelli
people.role_or_credentials: Franciscan physician; founder of the Catholic University of the Sacred Heart, Milan
people.position: Proposed a natural/psychological interpretation.
people.nuance: Did not conduct the authorized direct wound examination needed to equate his assessment with Bignami’s.
people.locator: Existing medical dossier; compare actual access to wounds
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Joseph Lemius, O.M.I.
people.role_or_credentials: Holy Office qualifier; Oblate procurator general
people.position: 1921 Voto favored a natural account and further investigation.
people.nuance: A dossier review, not personal medical examination. Avoid erroneous identification as a Dominican.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Enrico Morrica
people.position: Il Mattino article questioned miracle and wound interpretations.
people.nuance: Do not upgrade to a university medical examiner; original newspaper not recovered.
people.locator: Il Mattino 30 June 1919, “L’avventura francescana…”; printed pp. 55–56
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Valentini Vista
people.position: Reported chemical supply and suspected a wound connection.
people.nuance: No observed chemical wound production; connected to De Vito’s transaction, not independent fabrication.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Maria De Vito
people.category: Procurement witness, not necessarily blanket opponent
people.position: Reported requests, including discretion; sterilization purpose stated.
people.nuance: Preserve her testimony without turning procurement into observed fraud.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Giuseppe Maria da Sarezzano
people.position: 1952 memorandum repeated a breached-seal account.
people.nuance: Retrospective and secondhand; chronology/interpretation disputed in existing audit.
people.locator: Existing bandaging audit, original memorandum locator
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Pietro d’Ischitella
people.position: Raised concern about local fanaticism; organized wound controls.
people.nuance: Reported seal-story source; also supplied evidence of persistent wounds. Not a single-position opponent.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Clemente da Milwaukee
people.position: Requested visitation, including hospital administration, 14 April 1960.
people.nuance: Seeking an inquiry does not itself reject sanctity or prove sexual wrongdoing.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Bonaventura da Pavullo
people.position: Concerned about lay intrusion; involved in inquiry/surveillance arrangements.
people.nuance: Also described Pio favorably. Do not count as unqualified fraud accuser.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Mario Crovini
people.position: Associated with initial 1960 examination.
people.nuance: Later account objected to surveillance; separate investigation from endorsement of every charge.
people.locator: Positio IV p. 69; 1976 report S.O. 255/19 doc. 1225 p. 16
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Pellegrino da Sant’Elia a Pianisi
people.position: Questioned devotional excess; described three watched meetings as proper.
people.nuance: Supports conduct in those meetings, not a retrospective disproof of a 1920s affair.
people.locator: Positio II p. 241; Luzzatto printed p. 389
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Masseo da San Martino in Pensilis
people.position: Assisted surveillance.
people.nuance: Later regret reported while retaining esteem for Pio; participation is not firsthand proof of sexual activity.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Daniele da Roma
people.position: Named in the surveillance reconstruction.

people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Aurelio da Sant’Elia a Pianisi
people.position: Named in the surveillance reconstruction.

people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Emilio da Matrice
people.position: Named in the surveillance reconstruction.

people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Pietro Parente
people.position: Conveyed serious concerns to papal authorities.
people.nuance: No firsthand eyewitness evidence of intercourse recovered from him.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Pietro Palazzini
people.position: Named by Peña in the surveillance approval chain.
people.nuance: Underlying authorization not inspected; status as independent opponent unproved.
people.access_status: Lead through secondary narrative

people.name: Alfredo Ottaviani
people.position: Responsible for institutional investigation.
people.nuance: Commissioning an investigation is not independent eyewitness corroboration.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: John XXIII
people.position: Private notes record serious reported misconduct.
people.nuance: Conditional reception of allegations, not personal observation or a final sexual finding.
people.locator: Notes to printed pp. 392 onward; conditional Latin in papal record
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Marietta / “Manetta” Serritelli
people.role_or_credentials: Elvira’s sister as named in transmitted accounts
people.position: Reported remarks and gestures interpreted as hostile to Pio.
people.nuance: Do not silently identify with Angela Serritelli. Nested hearsay does not directly disprove Elvira’s alleged encounters.
people.access_status: Published evidence; original complete record not inspected

people.name: Vincenzo Tangaro
people.role_or_credentials: Physician, Naples, according to later accounts
people.position: Early skeptical medical statements attributed in later literature.
people.nuance: Attribution may overlap Morrica’s 30 June 1919 article. Original article and credentials not recovered; not counted as another verified examiner.
people.access_status: Lead only

people.name: Giuseppina Finocchi (name as printed)
people.position: Tosatti lists this name among alleged adversaries.
people.nuance: No specific signed accusation recovered. Do not invent a role, merge with another woman or treat this as independent evidence.
people.access_status: Unresolved identity/claim

people.name: “Padre Faustino” (name as printed)
people.role_or_credentials: Identity not established; possible naming error
people.position: Tosatti calls him the man of the recorders.
people.nuance: The book elsewhere names Giustino for recording. Possible error or another person; do not count an extra surveillance witness.
